_note: Backgrounds and cast. img = file name in src/assets/scenes/ (backgrounds) or src/assets/cast/ (portraits), without extension. focus = the point of the image (x, y in %) kept in view on small or tall screens; zoom scales in around it. Hotspot 'spot' positions in story.json are % of the background image. portraitX = where character portraits stand, as % of screen width from the left (default 6).
